_about: M1 seed scenario (PRD section 13): 20 synthetic Bengaluru reports that must collapse into the expected incidents. Coordinates sit inside the simplified ward fixtures in data/reference/bengaluru.geojson. Times are relative offsets in hours from the run start, so the scenario is reproducible on any day.
_expected: See expected_incidents below. The dedup path is scored on this in tests/test_pipeline_m1.py.
_language_note: All English. PRD section 5 expects Kannada and Hindi submissions; the lexical baseline behind common.llm cannot classify them, which is PRD open question 3. Those cases are deliberately absent rather than represented by text the pipeline would silently mishandle.

reports.text: Huge pothole outside the school gate, very deep and dangerous
Deep pothole near the school gate, autos are swerving around it
Dangerous pothole at the school gate, a child nearly fell in
Pothole outside the school gate is still not fixed after weeks
Waterlogging at the junction, knee deep water after the rain
Standing water at the junction, knee deep, cannot cross
Waterlogging near the junction again, water accumulating badly
Garbage dump near the market has not been cleared for days
Garbage piling up near the market, stray dogs everywhere
Garbage near the market still not collected, rubbish on the road
Street light not working on this lane, completely dark at night
Street light still not working, dark street is unsafe
Drain overflowing onto the road, blocked drain near the junction
Blocked drain overflowing again near the junction, choked drain
Big pothole on the main road here, very deep
Sewage smell and foul smell coming from the manhole here
Tree branch fell on the footpath after the storm
Pipeline burst on the road, water leaking continuously
Stray dog menace near the park, children are scared
Illegal parking blocking the road completely, traffic jam

_notes: pothole_indiranagar is a separate incident from pothole_school_gate despite sharing a category: it is ~4 km away, far outside the 75 m pothole radius. It guards against over-merging on category alone.

drain_overflow_lane sits ~70 m from waterlogging_junction and within its time window. They must stay separate incidents because A2 never merges across categories (PRD 7/A2); linking them is A3 pattern mode's job in P5, as a SuperIncident.
garbage_market has 3 reports from 2 devices, so distinct_reporters must be 2, not 3. This is the device-deduplication the corroboration score depends on (PRD 7/A4).

Compression ratio for this set is 20 reports / 11 incidents = 1.8x, below the >= 3x target in PRD section 14. That target assumes real duplicate density; this fixture deliberately includes singletons to test that A2 does NOT over-merge.
